christmas2026NumberBallSet.contractObject: Fabricación, grabación y suministro de un juego de bolas completo para el Sorteo Extraordinario de Navidad
christmas2026NumberBallSet.contractEndCondition: Entrega del Certificado de Aceptación correspondiente a la última entrega de bolas
christmas2026NumberBallSet.meaning: The 2026 Christmas number-ball replacement is a contractually bounded physical reset with acceptance evidence expected by contract design.

christmas2026PrizeBallSet.meaning: Prize-ball supply is separately traceable from the number-ball set.

currentDrawEquipmentMaintenance.officialPurpose: Mantenimiento y asistencia técnica de los equipos e instalaciones necesarios para la celebración de los sorteos y eventos de SELAE
currentDrawEquipmentMaintenance.meaning: Any machine-era segmentation for 2026 must be anchored to externally evidenced maintenance/intervention records, never inferred from outcomes.

ballWeighingGovernance.fact: La Comisión de Seguimiento, a propuesta de SELAE, establece semestralmente un calendario de pesajes periódicos de las bolas; funcionarios IGAE participan en el control.
ballWeighingGovernance.historicalIGAEProcedureEvidence: IGAE publication describes periodic weighing/control attendance and attestation of results to assure characteristics required for quality and randomness.
ballWeighingGovernance.meaning: Actual measurement records are the decisive missing evidence; nominal tolerances alone cannot support a predictive claim.

requiredBeforeTestingPhysicalBias: actual per-ball or statistically valid sampled mass measurements
dated weighing act/minutes or equivalent measurement record
dated machine maintenance/intervention records sufficient to define eras ex ante
forbiddenInference: treat specification tolerance as observed dispersion
define eras after inspecting winning numbers
transfer old Christmas ball-specific patterns to the all-new 2026 set

priorityTargets: Certificados de Aceptación and delivery/batch records for 25/042
SELAE/IGAE 2026 weighing calendar and weighing acts/results
Cayan 26/017 intervention/maintenance records that can timestamp machine-state changes
